labels.text: How can I help you today?

steps: Open the AGI side panel and sign in.
Click the message box that shows "How can I help you today?".
Type a plain sentence.
Press Enter, or click the send button (arrow icon, tooltip "Send").
Look for the sent message in the chat and compare with Expected.
S13.01.where: Side panel (after sign-in) > message box "How can I help you today?" > type text > press Enter or click the "Send message" button

labels.text: Send (Enter, Shift+Enter for a new line)
How can I help you today?

steps: Click the message box.
Type a first line, press Shift+Enter, type a second line.
Confirm the box still holds both lines and nothing was sent.
Press Enter to send.
Look at the sent message and check the line break is kept.
S13.02.where: Side panel > message box "How can I help you today?" > Shift+Enter for a new line

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S13.03.note: The cap is a CSS max-height of 120px on the composer input in apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts; no script resize code was found, so the growth rule is CSS-only and was not run.
steps: Click the message box.
Type or paste many lines of text, pressing Shift+Enter between them.
Watch the box height as lines are added.
Keep adding lines until the box stops growing and a scroll bar appears inside it.
Compare with Expected: grows, then scrolls at a cap.
S13.03.where: Side panel > message box "How can I help you today?" > keep typing

S13.06.note: When sending is blocked the button is disabled, but the code sets no reason text on it; any reason shown elsewhere was not traced.
steps: Click the message box and type text.
Look for the send button (arrow icon) at the right; it appears once text is typed.
Click it and watch the message go into the chat.
Clear the box and look at the send button; it hides when empty and no file is attached.
Compare with Expected: visible send button submits; blocked state is disabled.
S13.06.where: Side panel > message box > "Send message" button (arrow icon at the right of the box)

S13.07.note: While stopping, the button shows "Stopping…" and is disabled; whether the partial reply is kept was not traced in this pass.
steps: Send any message that gets a long reply.
While the reply is still streaming, look at the button at the right of the box (square icon).
Click it.
Watch the reply stop and check the text produced so far stays in the chat.
S13.07.where: Side panel > message box > send button becomes "Stop response" while a reply is generating

labels.text: Send (Enter, Shift+Enter for a new line)

steps: Click the message box.
Type some text.
Press Shift+Enter.
Check a new line appears and nothing is sent.
Compare with Expected: newline without sending.

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S13.10.note: Undo is the browser's own text undo; the code inserts dictated and pasted text with execCommand so it stays in the undo history.
steps: Click the message box and type a word.
Type a second word.
Press Cmd+Z and watch the last edit go.
Press Shift+Cmd+Z and watch it come back.
Compare with Expected: undo and redo revert and reapply edits.
S13.10.where: Side panel > message box "How can I help you today?" > Cmd+Z and Shift+Cmd+Z

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S13.11.needs: a copied image or file for the second half
steps: Copy some plain text from another page and click the message box.
Press Cmd+V and check the text appears in the box.
Copy an image or a file and press Cmd+V in the message box.
Look for an attachment chip above the box.
Compare with Expected: text is inserted and files or images become attachments.
S13.11.where: Side panel > message box "How can I help you today?" > Cmd+V

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S13.12.needs: a web page with formatted text to copy
S13.12.note: The code only intercepts pasted files; formatted text is left to the browser's plain-text textarea, so no extra cleaning code was found.
steps: Copy formatted text (bold, colours, links) from a web page.
Click the message box and press Cmd+V.
Look at the text: it should show as plain text with no styling.
Compare with Expected: clean plain text.
S13.12.where: Side panel > message box "How can I help you today?" > Cmd+V

labels.text: How can I help you today?

S13.16.note: Marked unfinished in the plan: text is kept for the current browser session only, so restart and other devices are not covered.
steps: Type a sentence in the message box but do not send it.
Close the side panel and open it again.
Look at the message box.
Compare with Expected: the unsent text is still there.
S13.16.where: Message box "How can I help you today?", seen after closing and reopening the side panel

S13.17.note: Plan says Chrome restart and authenticated side-panel acceptance are still open.
steps: Type unsent text in the message box.
Reload or close and reopen the side panel.
Look for the notice "Restored your unsent text." and the text in the box.
Compare with Expected: text is put back with a notice.
S13.17.where: Message box, with the notice "Restored your unsent text." after reopening the side panel

S13.18.needs: a signed-in account with two chats
S13.18.note: Plan says authenticated history navigation in the side panel is still unverified.
steps: In chat A, type unsent text and do not send.
Open "Recent chats" and open chat B.
Check the message box in chat B is empty.
Go back to chat A and check its unsent text is still there.
Compare with Expected: drafts are separate per chat.
S13.18.where: Side panel, when switching between chats via "Recent chats"

S13.21.note: Choosing from the slash list inserts only the command and a space; the saved prompt is expanded when the message is sent, so it is not shown in the box.
steps: Open the side panel and click "More".
Click "Shortcuts" (opens the options page) and click "Create shortcut"; enter a name and a prompt with the input placeholder.
Back in the side panel, click the message box and type "/" then the shortcut name.
Choose the shortcut from the list, type your own text after it, and send.
Compare with Expected: template is inserted and filled with your text.
S13.21.where: More > Shortcuts > Create shortcut (saved prompt), then side panel message box "How can I help you today?" > type "/" and choose the shortcut

labels.text: How can I help you today?

steps: Click the message box and type "/".
Look for the list of commands, each with a name and a short hint.
Type "/su" and check the list filters to "/summarize".
Press ArrowDown and Enter, or click an item.
Compare with Expected: filtered list, chosen by keyboard or pointer.
S13.22.where: Side panel > message box "How can I help you today?" > type "/"

labels.text: Start the chat in this project

S13.25.needs: a signed-in account with at least one project
steps: Sign in and make sure you have at least one project.
Click the message box and type "@".
Look for the "Tabs and projects" menu with the "Projects" heading.
Click a project under "Projects" (sub-line "Start the chat in this project").
Look for the "Project · NAME" chip above the box and compare with Expected.
S13.25.where: Side panel > message box "How can I help you today?" > type "@" > "Tabs and projects" menu > "Projects" > "Start the chat in this project"

S13.29.needs: two or more open browser tabs
S13.29.note: Mention is refused right after a reply or at the tab limit, with a notice.
steps: Open two or more browser tabs with web pages.
In the side panel, click the message box and type "@".
Look for the "Tabs" heading in the "Tabs and projects" menu.
Click one tab name.
Look for the attached page chip above the box and compare with Expected.
S13.29.where: Side panel > message box "How can I help you today?" > type "@" > "Tabs and projects" menu > "Tabs" group

S13.31.needs: a web page open in the browser
S13.31.note: Project and skill chips are also shown in the composer area; not traced beyond the page chip.
steps: Open a web page in the browser tab.
In the side panel, click the "+" button labelled "Add attachment".
Click "Add the browser page".
Look above the message box for a chip for that page; it shows "capturing…" then the page name.
Click the chip's remove control ("Remove" plus the page name) and check it disappears.
S13.31.where: Side panel > "Add attachment" (+) button > "Add the browser page"

S13.32.note: The cited side_panel.ts:6563 no longer holds this. Searched apps/extension for connector or source chips ("resources", "connectorResource", "spConnector" chip keys, "attachment-chip" kinds); only the "Connectors" item in the + menu and the answer-sources list ("Sources used for this answer") were found, not a pre-send source chip.

S13.35.note: Some items (for example Connectors, Create a video, Skills) are shown or disabled by account and state; the full list was not traced.
steps: Open the side panel and click the "+" button next to the message box.
Look at the "Attachment options" menu list.
Check for "Upload from device" and "Attach tabs" among the items.
Compare with Expected: the menu lists the ways to add files, media and context.
S13.35.where: Side panel > message box > "+" button ("Add attachment") > menu "Attachment options"

S13.36.needs: a microphone and Chrome microphone permission
steps: Click the microphone button next to the message box.
Read the "Before you dictate" notice and click "Continue".
Allow the microphone in Chrome when asked.
Speak; the words should appear in the message box.
Check the text is not sent until you press Enter or the send button.
S13.36.where: Side panel > message box > microphone button "Voice input" > "Before you dictate" > Continue

labels.text: Reply to send it after this answer

S13.40.needs: a signed-in account and a reply that is still generating
S13.40.note: Code queues the message and sends it after the current answer finishes; it does not steer the running task, which differs from Expected.
steps: Send a message that gets a long reply.
While it streams, click the message box and type a guidance message.
Press Enter.
Look for the "Queued" item above the box with Edit and Cancel.
Compare with Expected: guidance steers the running task without stopping it.
S13.40.where: Side panel > message box while a reply is generating (placeholder "Reply to send it after this answer") > Enter
